exposure: Body mass index (BMI) categories (underweight, normal weight, overweight, obese)
Institute of Medicine GWG categories (inadequate, adequate, excessive)
cohort: Pregnant women participating in the Riyadh Mother and Baby Multicenter Cohort Study (RAHMA)
finding: While excessive GWG was independently associated with an increased risk of hypertensive events during pregnancy, prepregnancy obesity was associated with more adverse outcomes including GDM, hypertensive events, emergency caesarean section, and macrosomia.
mod_finding: Prepregnancy obesity was associated with a higher risk of delivery by emergency caesarean section.
